description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractTenantEntity' which models tenant-related data for a database, including fields like title, region, country, address, contact info, and tenant profile ID. It includes constructors for initializing from Tenant objects or entities, and a method to convert to a Tenant object.
